interpretations.statement: Unreviewed interpretation: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] Does an in-scope Fund have a contemporaneous complex-product classification basis under this circular? True means aggregate direct and indirect private-market exposure is at least 50% of NAV or an operative SFC designation exists, requiring complex-product treatment on that basis. False means both bases are absent on established facts; it does not establish declassification following an earlier threshold crossing or non-complex status under other rules. Unknown inputs remain unknown unless an independently established branch determines the result. Out-of-scope funds receive no answer. This predicate confers no legal approval.
